definitions.explanation: Indicates something continuing without end. Used for genuine permanence, emotional emphasis, or hyperbolic expressions of a very long duration.

examples.japanese: {永遠|えいえん}に⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{永遠|えいえん}に⟦{続|つづ}けば→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: I wish this moment would last forever.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{失|うしな}われた→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{永遠|えいえん}に⟦{戻|もど}らない→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: Lives lost in war will never come back.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{永遠|えいえん}に⟦{終|お}わらない→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ん⟦じゃないか→じゃないか：29707_janaika⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I thought this meeting would never end.

notes:
Adverbial form of ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧ (eternity) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Used both literally (genuine permanence) and hyperbolically (feels like it will never end). Very common in emotional, poetic, and everyday contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {永遠|えいえん}に⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue forever
- {永遠|えいえん}に⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to never forget
- {永遠|えいえん}に⟦{失|うしな}われる→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to be lost forever
- {永遠|えいえん}に⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to never change

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: forever; indefinitely — warmer and more colloquial, often used for wishes and hopes
- ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: permanently; perpetually — more formal and factual, emphasizes official or physical permanence
- ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧: always; the whole time — emphasizes continuous duration from a point in time, less absolute than {永遠|えいえん}に
